findings.text: follow-on: the reflex's dispatch pass returns before composing whenever the selected text review carries no finding at all (findings = review_findings(review); if not findings: return at recovery_repair_dispatch.py:672-673), so a run whose text review is clean and whose separate figure review raises a blocking finding still composes no repair round end-to-end — exactly the defect §20 describes. The landed change makes the composer correct for that case but the reflex short-circuits above it; the guard lives in a module outside this node's declared write paths, so it is recorded rather than repaired here.

follow-on: the figure record's disposition re-keying (repair.py:653-666) and the self-figure guard (repair.py:600-602) are load-bearing behaviour the commit message and docstring advertise — an already-disposed figure finding must not be repaired again — yet no assertion in tests/test_a_blocking_figure_finding_resumes_the_worker.py exercises either; a regression in either would leave the whole added test file green.
